anime-impact.description: On the crash-zoom stop: 3 frames of full-screen negative, radial speed lines, and red-cyan fringing, all gone by frame 4.
anime-impact.title: anime-impact

attention-bounce.description: An icon bounces with growing height, squashing on each landing with dust puffs, until the camera leans in and a panel pops.
attention-bounce.title: attention-bounce

axial-stretch.description: Velocity-driven stretch: the faster an element flies, the longer it smears (up to 2.2x), squashing back on landing.
axial-stretch.title: axial-stretch

axis-rescale-shock.description: A new value bursts 220px out of the chart frame, forcing the axis to rescale: ticks swap, the grid densifies, the old line flattens.
axis-rescale-shock.title: axis-rescale-shock

barn-door-split.description: The old page splits into two halves that accelerate out to both sides, edges glowing, while the new page rises to meet the gap.
barn-door-split.title: barn-door-split

beat-cut-accelerando.description: Six full-screen hard cuts with halving intervals (16-12-8-6-4f) accelerate toward the target, then freeze dead on the main frame with a gentle push.
beat-cut-accelerando.title: beat-cut-accelerando

beat-pump.description: Every 24 frames the frame jumps to 1.08x and decays back while the title plates mis-register further each beat before snapping true.
beat-pump.title: beat-pump

bento-light-up.description: A dark 3x2 bento wall waits dimmed; amber light traces each cell border and the content brightens and lifts, cell by cell, until a slow push seals it.
bento-light-up.title: bento-light-up

blinds-slice.description: Twelve vertical slats flip in a staggered wave — the old page collapsing at one edge as the new one expands from the other, a bright seam riding the wave.
blinds-slice.title: blinds-slice

brake-reticle-lock.description: The scroll overshoots 30px past the target and springs back, and on the brake frame corner brackets fly in and bite with a popping label.
brake-reticle-lock.title: brake-reticle-lock

bullet-time-freeze-orbit.description: A growing chart freezes mid-animation while the camera orbits the hovering UI plane 55 degrees and back, then time resumes.
bullet-time-freeze-orbit.title: bullet-time-freeze-orbit

card-footage-cadence.description: Seven segments alternate UI footage (with slight pushes and pans) and black title cards (settling from 1.05x), cut on fixed beats.
card-footage-cadence.title: card-footage-cadence

cast-ensemble.description: Five named cursors spring in staggered, drift on sine paths, one types a cameo line, and the whole cast gathers to watch at the end.
cast-ensemble.title: cast-ensemble

changelog-scroll-brake.description: A 2400px scroll decelerates exponentially over 50 frames, motion blur driven by per-frame speed, and the target row lifts lit while the rest dim.
changelog-scroll-brake.title: changelog-scroll-brake

clock-wipe.description: A radar hand sweeps 360 degrees from screen center, revealing the new page in its wake along a multi-line glowing edge.
clock-wipe.title: clock-wipe

comic-panel-split.description: Three slanted comic panels show the same subject at three zooms, popping in 2 frames apart, each slowly pushing until the last panel eats the screen.
comic-panel-split.title: comic-panel-split

confetti-crossfire.description: Two side cannons fire 50 confetti chips each across the centerline in crossing arcs, tumbling until every chip falls out of frame.
confetti-crossfire.title: confetti-crossfire

contact-shadow-lift.description: A card lifts off the page with a growing, fading contact shadow beneath, then drops back with a tiny squash.
contact-shadow-lift.title: contact-shadow-lift

corner-spotlight-reveal.description: A radial spotlight expands from the corner at strictly linear speed — lit inside, black outside — until the full screen is on. Light as the transition.
corner-spotlight-reveal.title: corner-spotlight-reveal

counter-tick-sparks.description: Every counter tick spits 6-10 tiny sparks that leap and die under gravity; the final doubled value bursts 20 with a 1.1x number pop.
counter-tick-sparks.title: counter-tick-sparks

cube-rotate.description: Two pages share adjacent faces of a cube that rotates 90 degrees; the old face darkens out while the new one brightens in past a shadowed edge.
cube-rotate.title: cube-rotate

cursor-performance.description: A cursor swoops in on three bezier arcs with a wrist-flick overshoot, hovers, clicks the button into a ripple, and the camera pushes in.
cursor-performance.title: cursor-performance

diagram-cascade.description: A typed prompt sprouts a diagram tree: root, children, grandchildren pop layer by layer with connector lines drawing ahead of each node.
diagram-cascade.title: diagram-cascade

dialogue-duet.description: Two named cursors meet in a dark scene, converse in pulses, orbit-swap positions, trade the light, then one zooms huge to become the transition.
dialogue-duet.title: dialogue-duet

dolly-zoom.description: A faux dolly-zoom: the subject stays pinned while the background swells forward, building dramatic pressure.
dolly-zoom.title: dolly-zoom

domino-cascade.description: A title slams down, the shockwave pops a row of cards, and the last one shoves the sidebar into place — momentum handed down the line.
domino-cascade.title: domino-cascade

drift-assembly.description: Characters drift in from seeded directions with blur, locking into place one by one, each lock landing a darkening pulse.
drift-assembly.title: drift-assembly

drone-dive-landing.description: From a near-vertical hover the camera plunges, then air-brakes to a stop on the hero card close-up.
drone-dive-landing.title: drone-dive-landing

drop-blackout-slam.description: Mid-flow the screen cuts to 12 frames of dead black, then the hero visual slams in with screen shake and a flash ring.
drop-blackout-slam.title: drop-blackout-slam

dutch-roll-to-level.description: The pain-point section hangs at a -10 degree tilt with a slow drift, then rolls level in one overshooting move as the solution lands.
dutch-roll-to-level.title: dutch-roll-to-level

error-retype.description: Type, pause with a blinking cursor, backspace, retype without hesitation — a three-act correction that reads as human.
error-retype.title: error-retype

exploded-view.description: The page tilts into 3D and its parts blast apart along Z, hover a beat, then reassemble in reverse with a closing shake.
exploded-view.title: exploded-view

flash-cut.description: The camera pushes in and a white flash straddles the cut, hiding the page swap inside the flare.
flash-cut.title: flash-cut

flip-grid-reflow.description: Every card flies along its own straight line between two precomputed layouts with overshoot, landing on a single full-frame brightness pulse.
flip-grid-reflow.title: flip-grid-reflow

flyline-arc.description: A glowing head draws a bezier flyline between cards in 22 frames, the tail fading behind it; the endpoint pulses on arrival.
flyline-arc.title: flyline-arc

font-weight-pump.description: On each hit the strokes jump bold and spring back thin over 10 frames; accent beats also widen the word 8%.
font-weight-pump.title: font-weight-pump

freeze-annotate.description: The stream freezes mid-flow, a circled annotation pops on the frozen frame, then everything thaws and keeps moving.
freeze-annotate.title: freeze-annotate

glow-orb-ambient.description: Three huge blurred glow orbs drift on twin sine paths, driving edge-light on nearby cards by distance.
glow-orb-ambient.title: glow-orb-ambient

glow-wake-sleep-panel.description: Wake-and-sleep sweep: a reveal mask follows the light head left to right — lit where it passes, sinking back to dark behind it.
glow-wake-sleep-panel.title: glow-wake-sleep-panel

grid-flash-mosaic.description: Nine tiles flash in one every 2 frames in shuffled order until the wall is full, breathes once, then the center tile swallows the screen.
grid-flash-mosaic.title: grid-flash-mosaic

grid-wave-flip.description: A 3x3 wall of gray card backs flips in place along a diagonal wavefront, each card revealing its face, the last one overshooting into place.
grid-wave-flip.title: grid-wave-flip

halation-bloom.description: A blurred, brightened copy underneath the text flares on the impact frame and settles into a steady soft glow.
halation-bloom.title: halation-bloom

hit-counter.description: Three cards slam in one after another; every hit freezes 2 frames, floats damage digits, and bumps the combo counter.
hit-counter.title: hit-counter

icon-flip-bloom.description: The icon rocks twice, flips flat to a sliver with double ghosting, swaps identity at the thinnest frame, and blooms into a five-petal mark as the wordmark lands.
icon-flip-bloom.title: icon-flip-bloom

impact-burst-kit.description: The full landing kit plus a physically-timed shockwave that shoves neighboring cards 30px outward with damped tilts as it passes.
impact-burst-kit.title: impact-burst-kit

input-morph-assemble.description: Send is clicked, the text flies off, the input box spring-morphs into a capsule, and three glyphs drop in from off-screen to assemble the logo petal.
input-morph-assemble.title: input-morph-assemble

invisible-cut.description: An oversized card sweeps past the lens with heavy motion blur, and the background swaps scenes inside the fully-covered frames.
invisible-cut.title: invisible-cut

jump-cut-punch-in.description: Three zoom steps with zero tweening, origin pinned on the target, each jump landing with a darkening pulse like a tick.
jump-cut-punch-in.title: jump-cut-punch-in

kanada-perspective-snap.description: Kanada-style snap: perspective 300 to 1500, rotate3d 58 degrees to flat, scale 1.7 to 1 in 18 frames, with a 4-frame overshoot as long shadows settle.
kanada-perspective-snap.title: kanada-perspective-snap

karaoke-fill-sync.description: Each word fills dark-to-bright left to right at speech speed and stays lit, a reading underline tracking the active word.
karaoke-fill-sync.title: karaoke-fill-sync

keycap-smash-cut.description: A keycap breathes, squashes with a glowing fuse ring, cards roar past the lens accelerating, then one frame smash-cuts to a still wide shot.
keycap-smash-cut.title: keycap-smash-cut

letter-drop-physics.description: Characters fall from above under gravity, bounce twice, land crooked, then square up together on the final beat.
letter-drop-physics.title: letter-drop-physics

letterform-zoom.description: The next page shows through a giant letterform cut as a mask; the camera zooms through the letter until it swallows the frame.
letterform-zoom.title: letterform-zoom

light-leak-burn.description: Three amber light blooms sweep the diagonal, and at peak coverage the old page hard-cuts away beneath the flare.
light-leak-burn.title: light-leak-burn

line-unfold-panel.description: CRT grammar: a line snaps open horizontally, then unfolds to full panel height with content fading in a beat early.
line-unfold-panel.title: line-unfold-panel

mask-wipe.description: A real element in the page — a card — scales up into a full-screen window, and the next scene grows out from inside it.
mask-wipe.title: mask-wipe

masking-tape-slap.description: A card wobbles on sine sway until two tape strips slap down and pin it dead — torn edges cut by a jagged clip path.
masking-tape-slap.title: masking-tape-slap

misregistration-hit.description: The title slams in and splits into two color plates offset 32px, oscillating down until they snap back into register with a scale pulse.
misregistration-hit.title: misregistration-hit

multiplane.description: A multiplane parallax dolly: three layers slide at different speeds, pulling depth out of flat screenshots.
multiplane.title: multiplane

needle-sweep-selftest.description: Ignition self-test: gauge needles slam to full arc, then swing back with overshoot to their true values, staggered across dials.
needle-sweep-selftest.title: needle-sweep-selftest

orb-flyline-relay.description: Orbs and flylines welded together: a background orb surges on the exact frame its flyline lands, so backdrop answers foreground.
orb-flyline-relay.title: orb-flyline-relay

oscilloscope-stream.description: A live curve writes itself in at the right edge with sudden spikes, then brakes to a true standstill.
oscilloscope-stream.title: oscilloscope-stream

overhead-tabletop-drop.description: A card array lies at 62 degrees overhead; the camera pans across the tabletop, then dives and lands on the layout.
overhead-tabletop-drop.title: overhead-tabletop-drop

palette-theme-ripple.description: The command palette collapses to a bright point, and from that point a circular ripple floods the new theme across the screen.
palette-theme-ripple.title: palette-theme-ripple

panel-to-canvas.description: Checkboxes tick themselves, then table rows arc out of the panel and morph mid-flight into canvas cards, landing with casual tilts.
panel-to-canvas.title: panel-to-canvas

paparazzi-flash.description: Three white flashes each hard-cut to a different crop of the same subject (wide, card, digits), settling on the number.
paparazzi-flash.title: paparazzi-flash

pop-burst-confirm.description: 'A check icon coils, springs oversized, and bursts radial particles plus an expanding ring — the punctuation mark of "done".'
pop-burst-confirm.title: pop-burst-confirm

popup-book-rise.description: Pop-up book: cards hinge up from a 75-degree tabletop one by one on springs, far row first, each overshooting past vertical.
popup-book-rise.title: popup-book-rise

pull-back-isolation.description: The camera pulls back from one glowing card while its siblings go dark by distance, leaving it alone in a black field.
pull-back-isolation.title: pull-back-isolation

reticle-lock-on.description: Four corner brackets fly in and clamp onto the target with an overshoot snap; the target brightens and its label pops.
reticle-lock-on.title: reticle-lock-on

score-slam.description: A card drops from 2.5x scale and 5 degrees in six accelerating frames; the landing frame fires a shock ring, dust, and screen shake at once.
score-slam.title: score-slam

scramble-decode.description: All characters flicker as noise, then lock to the real glyphs left to right, each lock flashing inverted for 2 frames as a progress bar tracks.
scramble-decode.title: scramble-decode

shared-element-morph.description: The full-screen close-up card shrinks, travels, and grows corners, flying seamlessly into its slot in the dashboard grid with a 3% overshoot.
shared-element-morph.title: shared-element-morph

sheen-sweep.description: A single 45-degree highlight band sweeps once across a dark card, clipped by its rounded corners.
sheen-sweep.title: sheen-sweep

shot-transitions-4.description: The camera pushes past the foreground into pure darkness, glides a few frames, and the next scene scales up out of the depth — one unbroken take.
shot-transitions-4.title: shot-transitions-4

shot-transitions-5.description: The outgoing shot slides out of focus while the incoming one racks in — the focal plane itself is the cut.
shot-transitions-5.title: shot-transitions-5

shot-transitions-6.description: The shot fades to black, a typewriter title card lands, then hands off to the next scene.
shot-transitions-6.title: shot-transitions-6

slide-spotlight-pan.description: Edge-hugging glow: the beam rounds the corner and rides the top edge, violet bleed seeping into the UI, while the panel slides opposite like a camera pan.
slide-spotlight-pan.title: slide-spotlight-pan

slow-push-in.description: A four-second uniform push from 1.00 to 1.14 with a deepening vignette, then a hard cut to the bright scene at peak tension.
slow-push-in.title: slow-push-in

smash-cut.description: Everything accelerates — background zooming, five cards rushing the lens, speed-gated blur — then one frame smash-cuts to a motionless wide.
smash-cut.title: smash-cut

speed-ramp.description: Nonlinear frame remap: fast flow drops to a 0.2x stare on the key moment, then accelerates away.
speed-ramp.title: speed-ramp

split-text-stagger.description: Each character rises inside its own overflow box from 115% with a 10% overshoot, two frames apart, as the baseline grows beneath.
split-text-stagger.title: split-text-stagger

spotlight-sweep.description: Two copies of the text: a dim one always on, a bright one revealed by a radial mask that sweeps twice before locking fully lit.
spotlight-sweep.title: spotlight-sweep

strobe-black-frames.description: Full black frames strobe on a fixed schedule, intervals tightening from 8 to 3 frames, and the last flash lifts straight into the locked shot.
strobe-black-frames.title: strobe-black-frames

tape-scroll-fixed-pointer.description: The pointer holds still while a long scale tape crawls, sprints at 45px/f, and spring-brakes onto the final reading.
tape-scroll-fixed-pointer.title: tape-scroll-fixed-pointer

terminal-typewriter.description: A command types at 2 frames per character, and the enter key detonates the scene: a 6-frame zoom through the prompt into the dashboard.
terminal-typewriter.title: terminal-typewriter

text-on-path.description: Characters slide in single-file along a bezier curve, rotating with the tangent, then straighten level over 12 frames.
text-on-path.title: text-on-path

theme-sweep-toggle.description: The dark theme sweeps across as a slanted clip-path edge with a glowing 4px line, recoloring everything it passes in one 38-frame pass.
theme-sweep-toggle.title: theme-sweep-toggle

tilt-reveal.description: The whole page lies flat at -80 degrees and tilts upright in one 43-frame ease-out with a slight overshoot at the end.
tilt-reveal.title: tilt-reveal

tracking-expand.description: Letters unfold from stacked negative tracking to open spacing while the blur clears on the same curve.
tracking-expand.title: tracking-expand

trailer-bumper.description: Three 9-frame shots hard-cut in strict time, each with a tiny internal push, then 6 frames of black silence before the title rises.
trailer-bumper.title: trailer-bumper

unit-dot-swarm-regroup.description: A dot swarm migrates in three staggered spring acts and finally regroups into a number.
unit-dot-swarm-regroup.title: unit-dot-swarm-regroup

versus-slam.description: Two half-screens with slanted edges charge from opposite sides and collide; the impact frame is the cut — white flash, shake, VS stamp.
versus-slam.title: versus-slam

whip-pan.description: The camera whips sideways so hard the middle frames smear illegible, and the new scene is waiting when it stops.
whip-pan.title: whip-pan

wireframe-draw-on.description: The interface draws itself as blueprint linework first, then a glowing amber scanline sweeps left to right, solidifying wireframe into real UI.
wireframe-draw-on.title: wireframe-draw-on

wright-triple-cut.description: Three 10-frame extreme close-ups hard-cut in a row — still, move, still — and the third snaps back to a wide with the result.
wright-triple-cut.title: wright-triple-cut
